mapper.sql: id , username, nick_name, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, ua.id AS accountId, u.nick_name AS nickName, ua.account_type AS accountType, ua.account_value AS accountValue, r.name AS roleName FROM t_sys_user u LEFT JOIN t_sys_user_account ua ON ua.id = #{accountId} AND ua.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0
